synthesis.formal_statement: Planets orbit in ellipses with sun at focus; equal areas in equal times; T² ∝ a³

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — laws ARE relations: orbit shape ↔ focus position, area ↔ time, period ↔ semi-major axis
Orbital motion is continuous process
Distinguishes elliptical from circular orbits

synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (proportionality relations) → laws vanish, they ARE the mathematical relations. Remove ⟳ (orbital process) → static geometric relations remain. Remove Δ → relations still hold. ⇄ is essential.

synthesis.formal_statement: Laws of mechanics are identical in all inertial reference frames

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — distinguishes inertial from non-inertial frames as fundamental category
Relates physics across different frames via Galilean transformations
Minimal — principle about frame equivalence, not dynamics

synthesis.dimension_hints: D=3 (volumetric) — operates in 3D space with absolute time
synthesis.elimination_test: Remove Δ (inertial frame distinction) → principle vanishes, it IS about that classification. Remove ⇄ (frame transformations) → distinction remains. Remove ⟳ → already static principle. Δ is essential.
synthesis.oscillation_notes: Δ/⇄ tension: principle presupposes inertial frame distinction (Δ) but affirms invariance of laws across frames (⇄). Elimination test resolves toward Δ: Galileo historically introduces the concept of inertial frame through this principle. Σ₃₂₁₊ alternative defensible if focus on inter-frame equivalence.

synthesis.formal_statement: P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant — relates pressure, velocity, and height in fluid flow

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — principle IS the trade-off relation: pressure ↔ velocity ↔ height
Fluid flow is continuous process
Distinguishes different energy forms in fluid

synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (energy trade-off) → principle vanishes, it IS the conservation relation. Remove ⟳ (flow) → static energy equation remains. Remove Δ → relation still holds. ⇄ is essential.

synthesis.formal_statement: Pressure applied to confined fluid transmits undiminished to all points

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — principle IS the static equality relation: P₁ = P₂ = P₃... at all points
Transmission is physical mechanism, not ontological essence
Distinguishes confined from open fluid

synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (pressure equality) → principle vanishes, there's nothing to say. Remove ⟳ (transmission mechanism) → static equilibrium P₁=P₂ remains. Remove Δ → equality still holds. ⇄ is essential.

synthesis.formal_statement: PV = nRT — relates pressure, volume, temperature, and amount of gas

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — law IS the multi-way relation among P, V, T, n
Gas molecules in continuous thermal motion
Distinguishes ideal from real gas behavior

synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (PVT relation) → law vanishes, it IS the equation of state. Remove ⟳ (molecular motion) → macroscopic relation remains. Remove Δ → relation still holds. ⇄ is essential.

synthesis.formal_statement: n₁ sin θ₁ = n₂ sin θ₂ — relates incident and refracted angles at interface

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — law IS the relation: incident angle ↔ refracted angle via refractive indices
Distinguishes two media at interface
Light propagation across boundary

synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (angle relation) → law vanishes, it IS the proportionality. Remove Δ (media distinction) → presupposed but relation holds mathematically. Remove ⟳ → static geometric law remains. ⇄ is essential.

synthesis.formal_statement: Observed frequency changes when source or observer moves: f' = f(v±v₀)/(v±vₛ)

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — effect IS the relation: motion ↔ frequency shift
Wave propagation and motion are continuous processes
Distinguishes approaching from receding motion

synthesis.dimension_hints: D=2 (linear) — motion along line, directional effect
synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (velocity↔frequency relation) → effect vanishes, it IS the frequency shift formula. Remove ⟳ (wave propagation) → presupposed but relation remains. Remove Δ → relation still holds. ⇄ is essential.

synthesis.formal_statement: ∮ E·dl = -dΦ_B/dt — changing magnetic flux induces electric field

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — law IS about temporal change: dΦ/dt generates field
Relates magnetic flux to induced electric field
Distinguishes static from changing flux

synthesis.dimension_hints: D=4 (field/temporal) — electromagnetic field evolution in spacetime
synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⟳ (temporal change dΦ/dt) → law vanishes, induction IS about time variation. Remove ⇄ (flux-field relation) → change still there but not induction. Remove Δ → change still defined. ⟳ is essential.

synthesis.formal_statement: Induced current opposes the change in magnetic flux that produced it

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — law IS the opposition relation: induced effect ↔ opposing cause
Change in flux is temporal process
Distinguishes direction of induced vs original flux

synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (opposition relation) → law vanishes, it IS about the opposing response. Remove ⟳ (flux change) → presupposed by Faraday but opposition is relational. Remove Δ → opposition still defined. ⇄ is essential.
synthesis.oscillation_notes: ⇄/⟳ tension: Faraday (Σ₄₃₁₊) describes THAT induction occurs (process), Lenz describes HOW it relates to its cause (opposition). Not 'same phenomenon from two angles' — complementary but distinct. The minus sign is a relation between cause and effect, not a property of the process. Σ₄₃₁₊ alternative valid if viewed as inseparable from Faraday's process.

synthesis.formal_statement: ∮ B·dl = μ₀I — relates magnetic field circulation to enclosed current

ontological_structures.evidence: PRIMARY — law IS the relation: current ↔ magnetic field circulation
Current is continuous charge flow
Distinguishes enclosed from non-enclosed current

synthesis.dimension_hints: D=3 (volumetric) — magnetic field around 3D current distribution
synthesis.elimination_test: Remove ⇄ (current↔field relation) → law vanishes, it IS the proportionality. Remove ⟳ (current flow) → static relation still holds. Remove Δ → relation still valid. ⇄ is essential.
